text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position and thesis in the opening paragraph","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its stance and main claims up front so the reader immediately knows what argument it will develop."},{"evidence":"three organized body paragraphs on guidelines, laws, and costs","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is structured into distinct points that build the case in a more logical and easy-to-follow way."},{"evidence":"explains why laws must change before driverless cars can advance","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay develops its reasoning by showing how policy restrictions block progress rather than only making a general claim."},{"evidence":"uses the Google taxi fuel quote and the BMW sensor detail to support claims","quality":"textual support integration","description":"The essay weaves in article evidence in a relevant way to back up its points instead of just mentioning details."},{"evidence":"concluding paragraph restates the main position and broader significance","quality":"conclusion effectiveness","description":"The ending clearly wraps up the argument by reinforcing the thesis and its larger implication."}]}
